name: guest.edit
description: "Can edit" (decision 6): a guest changes the brief's hook, angle and storyboard titles, and nothing else; never adds or removes a shot. A new hook carries to the idea's post unless it is out.
sql:
with l as (select * from brandbase.share_links where token = :token),
edited as (
  update brandbase.ideas i set
    hook = coalesce(btrim(:hook), i.hook),
    angle = coalesce(:angle, i.angle),
    shots = case when :shots::jsonb is null then i.shots else coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(case when n.title is null then x else x || jsonb_build_object('title', n.title) end order by o)
      from jsonb_array_elements(i.shots) with ordinality t(x, o)
      left join lateral (select s ->> 'title' as title from jsonb_array_elements(:shots::jsonb) s where s ->> 'id' = x ->> 'id' limit 1) n on true), '[]') end,
    version = i.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from l where i.id = l.target_id
  returning i.*
),
carried as (
  update brandbase.posts p set hook = btrim(:hook), version = p.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from edited e where :hook::text is not null and p.id = e.post_id and brandbase.post_stage(p.id) <> 'posted'
  returning p.id
)
select jsonb_build_object('hook', e.hook, 'angle', e.angle, 'shots', e.shots) as result from edited e
